title: GitHub Desktop now supports multiple accounts per host
author: Allison

summary: GitHub Desktop now lets you sign in with more than one account on the same host, including GitHub.com, GitHub Enterprise Server, and GHE.com. This has been one of the most requested features in the Desktop community.
takeaways: With this release, you can: Add more than one account for a single host, with no fixed limit.
Associate each repository with a specific account, so clone, publish, and Git operations use the right credentials automatically.

To get started, download the latest (GitHub Desktop 3.7.0) and open Settings/Options > Accounts to add another account, then use the new account picker when cloning, publishing, or reviewing a repository’s settings.
